title: Filing record
description: One extracted 10-K Item 9A record, written by 02_extract_item9a to gcs://<bucket>/processed/. Unlabeled.

accession_number.description: Primary key. The only stable unique identifier for a filing.

item_9a_text.description: Extracted Item 9A span. Records failing the minimum length are diverted to the extraction-failure list, never truncated into processed/.

extraction_method.description: How the span boundaries were found. Recorded so a parser change can be traced, and so heading_to_end records — where no following item heading existed and the span was taken to a length cap — can be counted and reviewed separately.

filer_status.description: Affects whether an auditor attestation on ICFR was required.
